//: ts-jest-only tsconfig. Maps @sylphie/shared to the SOURCE (../shared/src) so ts-jest type-checks specs against the live monorepo source instead of a possibly-stale ../shared/dist build (which caused TS2339 'THEATER_PROHIBITED does not exist' when the worktree dist predated the enum addition). Kept separate from tsconfig.json so the package's `tsc -p` build (separate-process deploy) is NOT affected — exactly the split decision-making uses via its tsconfig paths.
